anchor_text: <Dialogue speaker="Fr. Andrew Stephen Damick" time="01:07:25">Welcome back to the Lord of Spirits podcast, where it's the weirdest Bible study ever. I am [[Father Andrew]] Stephen Damick in Emmaus, Pennsylvania, and my co-host, [[Father Stephen]] De Young, is with me from Lafayette, Louisiana.</Dialogue>
<Dialogue speaker="Fr. Stephen De Young" time="06:34:51">And then to judge is to come and put that back into whack, right?</Dialogue>
<Dialogue speaker="Fr. Andrew Stephen Damick" time="38:00">Yeah, that he's going to be part of that resurrection.</Dialogue>
<Dialogue speaker="Fr. Andrew Stephen Damick" time="09:15:20">Thank you very much and [[Christ]] is risen!</Dialogue>
